data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (31 December 2021) was 4,939.1 (USD millions). No material gross prior-year reserve movement is evident from the claims development tables for the years up to 2020 (net prior-year movement effectively nil), and the report notes that 2020 and prior years have been impacted by loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in 2018 and 2021 (Riverstone/Syndicate 3500), which can distort development patterns. The syndicate cites major loss activity in 2022 (Hurricane Ian, Russia/Ukraine) and ongoing inflationary pressures, but these are described as current-year issues; COVID-19 reserves are materially unchanged. Overall the prior year development is reported as flat.
raw_causal_phrases: loss portfolio reinsurance contracts entered into in the 2018 and 2021 calendar years with Riverstone Managing Agency Limited (for and on behalf of Lloyd's Syndicate 3500).
major loss activity including losses arising from Hurricane Ian and the Russian invasion of Ukraine
COVID-19 related reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021.
The Syndicate's reserves continue to be set at a margin above the actuarial best estimate incorporating management's current view of social and economic inflation.
data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure is stated in the notes. Prior-year development was computed from the published gross claims development table (triangle) which shows effectively no net movement for underwriting years up to 2020. The report also notes that 2020 and prior years were impacted by loss portfolio reinsurance (LPR/RITC) in 2018 and 2021 (Riverstone), which can distort development patterns; this may reduce the reliability of triangle-derived PYD. All amounts are reported in the native currency of the report (USD millions).
